name: rvc_status
summary: Manual heater and alarm-mask commands over RV-C, CAN1 poll fix, status broadcast

name: cvl
summary: Adds: IR3 sets the charge voltage limit, 52.0-57.0 V (IR3 = 0 keeps stock 54.7 V)

name: slew256
summary: Adds: the charge current limit falls at most 1/256 per 100 ms

name: uvcharge
summary: Adds: the alternator can charge a low pack; the mask lease also hides the difference L1 alarms
